description: This script analyzes Android.bp files in an Android source tree to verify dependency correctness, focusing on VNDK and vendor modules.

methods.name: _check_module_deps
methods.description: Checks dependencies of a module for correctness based on VNDK and vendor rules.

methods.name: _check_modules_deps
methods.description: Checks dependencies for all modules in the provided module dictionary.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for root_bp path and optional namespaces.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates dependency checking and outputs errors.
